name: Basic Medical Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Interdisciplinary biomedical research doctorate with three first-year rotations and guaranteed stipend, tuition and single health coverage.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Recurring deadline; page still links Apply for Fall 2026, so Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

applicationFee.note: Central international graduate processing fee $60; program explicitly offers no application fee waiver. Central international rules also require $500 admission deposit before I-20/DS-2019 issuance.

english.toefl: Program recommends 100 (scale not identified); central graduate minimum 71 legacy or 4 current
english.note: IELTS 7 is the program’s recommended score, compared with central minimum 6. Program also recommends iTEP 4.5/PTE 68. Program does not offer English waivers and requires scores for internationals without prior US college/university attendance; central exemption requires US bachelor’s. Confirm any prior-US-study exception. No generic overseas English-medium exemption.

documents: Transcripts (unofficial accepted for review; official after admission)
Three recommendation letters requested through application system
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor’s or US equivalent and satisfactory previous standing. Master’s not required; research experience highly recommended but not required. Recommended preparation: two semesters/three quarters each of physics, general/organic chemistry, biology, English composition and mathematics including calculus/statistics. Interview on campus or video. No prior PI needed; three first-year 8 week rotations before mentor agreement.

funding.note: All admitted BMS students, explicitly including international students, receive full tuition, single health coverage and stipend. Program FAQ publishes undated annual stipend $31, 000; student pays fees. Confirm current amount.
